say:1:1530346001:1.text: Yeah. Traveling there now would be suicide.
say:1:1530346001:1.source_cn: 是啊。现在的呼临城可不适合旅行。
say:1:1530346001:1.male: Yeah. Traveling there now would be suicide.
say:1:1530346001:1.female: Yeah. Traveling there now would be suicide.

say:2:1530346002:1.text: The rain was insane! Dry one moment, knee-deep water the next!
say:2:1530346002:1.source_cn: 暴雨、洪水！你能想象吗？！前一秒还干得要命，下一秒水就...
say:2:1530346002:1.male: The rain was insane! Dry one moment, knee-deep water the next!
say:2:1530346002:1.female: The rain was insane! Dry one moment, knee-deep water the next!

say:3:1530346003:1.text: Good thing I ran fast, or I'd be trapped in the flood too!
say:3:1530346003:1.source_cn: 要不是我跑得快，说不定也被洪水困住了！
say:3:1530346003:1.male: Good thing I ran fast, or I'd be trapped in the flood too!
say:3:1530346003:1.female: Good thing I ran fast, or I'd be trapped in the flood too!
